# History of `experiments/rhm`

*Auto-generated by a research summarizer. Big-picture narrative, not a changelog — see [README.md](README.md) and [FILES.md](FILES.md) for current state and full file index.*

**Span**: 2026-06-20 → 2026-07-28 (~5 weeks, still active). **Origin**: [ideas/language_reduction.md](../../ideas/language_reduction.md) — natural-language reduction experiments found vocab-only reduction is a channel intervention (β, not γ) and couldn't cleanly separate DGP from channel effects. RHM ([Cagnetta & Wyart 2024](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.13991)) supplies a synthetic hierarchical grammar with a *known* generative process, letting every later experiment ask "is this a DGP effect or a channel/instrument effect?" with a real answer.

## Act 1 — building trustworthy instruments (06-20 → 06-23)

The opening move was the obvious one: train models across (L, m) and measure a forward-model's (FM) residual — rank, cosine, norm — as a proxy for how much of the model's computation the FM had captured. [SWEEP_README.md](SWEEP_README.md) found `m` (synonymic multiplicity) dominates scaling exponent α_D over `L` (depth) ~3:1. But [RESIDUAL_RANK_README.md](RESIDUAL_RANK_README.md)'s capacity sweep delivered the arc's first real lesson: effective rank *rose* with FM capacity — the opposite of "rank reflects DGP complexity." It was tracking how uniformly the FM's *own* approximation error was distributed, not the DGP. This result would not be fully resolved until Act 5. [REGIME_TRANSITION_README.md](REGIME_TRANSITION_README.md) then found the field's central recurring phenomenon: an **L-to-m transition**, where a well-scaled model (6L/6H/192D, L=6, m=4) shows FM residual structure shifting from a diffuse capacity-gap to a rule/feature-conditioned gap over training — this setting became the project's default. [PER_LEVEL_LOSS_README.md](PER_LEVEL_LOSS_README.md) gave the mechanism: learning is strictly **bottom-up** (leaves first), producing a **composition-depth ceiling** partway up the hierarchy.

## Act 2 — is the ceiling an objective bias or a capacity limit? (06-22 → 06-23)

The natural hypothesis: NTP's sharpening/position-weighting bias causes the ceiling, so de-bias the loss. [LABEL_SMOOTHING_README.md](LABEL_SMOOTHING_README.md) falsified this cleanly — smoothing changes confidence, not depth, at every ε. [LOSS_WEIGHTING_README.md](LOSS_WEIGHTING_README.md)'s focal-loss/confidence-threshold/FM-surprise-weighted-NTP experiments found something more interesting instead: gradient reallocation toward under-confident positions doesn't buy compositional depth, but it does make the model **more legible to its own forward model** (cosine 0.925→0.995 in the best variant). The ceiling is a capacity/signal constraint (confirmed later, definitively, by [PER_LEVEL_EXPANSION_README.md](PER_LEVEL_EXPANSION_README.md), 07-13: a >200× parameter sweep leaves the ceiling untouched, while sweeping `m` alone walks it from level 2 to level 0 — **synonymity, not capacity, sets the ceiling**). Legibility, not depth, became the lever worth pulling — motivating everything in Act 3.

## Act 3 — the ratchet arc: a five-week negative result (06-23 → 06-29)

The MNIST "gated ratchet" (self-knowledge pressure compounding 34%→48% over 4 cycles) was ported wholesale to RHM in [`ratchet/README.md`](ratchet/README.md), which now holds nine concluded sub-experiments. Each ruled out one candidate confound: capacity/overparameterization ([RHM_L4_RATCHET](ratchet/RHM_L4_RATCHET_README.md)), lack of headroom ([RATCHET_M2](ratchet/RHM_RATCHET_M2_README.md)), supervision density (real lever, but a one-cycle effect — [SPARSITY_SWEEP](ratchet/RHM_SPARSITY_SWEEP_README.md), [SPARSE_RATCHET](ratchet/RHM_SPARSE_RATCHET_README.md)), task structure and the distillation bottleneck ([RL_RATCHET](ratchet/RHM_RL_RATCHET_README.md), fixed via generation-based distillation), and finally the meta-learning framing itself — [RHM_FOMAML](ratchet/RHM_FOMAML_README.md) and [RHM_META_LEARNING](ratchet/RHM_META_LEARNING_README.md) show FOMAML/Reptile collapse to plain multitask on stationary data ("the outer loop is identical to the inner loop"). **The dynamics of MNIST's ratchet all reproduce; the magnitude never does.** The arc's own diagnosis: compounding needs a *moving frontier*, which stationary RHM cannot supply — this single sentence redirects the rest of the project's second half toward either (a) making the frontier genuinely legible without a loop, or (b) making RHM's task itself non-stationary/active (Acts 5-6).

## Act 4 — self-knowledge without the ratchet (06-30 → 07-07)

In parallel, [RHM_FRONTIER_AND_LEGIBILITY_README.md](RHM_FRONTIER_AND_LEGIBILITY_README.md) (started 06-30, before the ratchet arc even concluded) corrected its own working assumption mid-document — occupancy isn't the control variable, **m alone gates learnable depth** — and found "knowledge-grok without circuit-grok": at m=2 the model reaches the Bayes-optimal ceiling, but its circuit stays high-rank under a weight-decay sweep 100x stronger than standard, floor ~77%. That floor became the target to beat: [RHM_FM_REGULARIZER_README.md](RHM_FM_REGULARIZER_README.md) (07-01) shows open-loop FM-predictability pressure (no injection, no distillation) pushes activation rank to 42.9% — **beating weight decay's floor while deepening η²**, i.e. self-knowledge pressure *is* load-bearing for functional (not merely L2) simplification, without needing the ratchet's closed loop at all. [RHM_LATENT_LOOP_README.md](RHM_LATENT_LOOP_README.md) (07-06) then found the real reason the ratchet's token-target loop never worked: a token target only makes the *already-reached* levels legible, and closing the loop under it actively **inverts** self-knowledge; only an oracle-latent target moves structure to the root, producing RHM's first genuine, FM-invariant, generalizable self-knowledge signal. [RHM_COMPLEXODYNAMICS_README.md](RHM_COMPLEXODYNAMICS_README.md) (07-07) reads these same saved trajectories against Aaronson's "First Law" and adds two amendments: the fall requires an *annealer* (SGD alone freezes mid-descent — "a glass, not a liquid"), and the curve doesn't descend to zero but to the **DGP's own sophistication relative to the observer's bound** — confirmed by a fresh-FM-ensemble run separating FM-idiosyncratic transient scaffolding from a DGP-aligned, ensemble-invariant floor.

## Act 5 — the instrument itself was wrong (07-27)

A full month after the original residual-rank result, [residual_decomposition/README.md](residual_decomposition/README.md) goes back and explains it. The standing belief ([beliefs/dimensionality_expansion.md](../../beliefs/dimensionality_expansion.md)) that activations partition as `R_act ≈ R_comp + R_res` is falsified as arithmetic, not just as data: entropy-based rank isn't subadditive, so `R_res` can exceed `R_act` and is blind to magnitude — exactly the anomaly Act 1 hit and never resolved. The replacement is two numbers: **β** (`res_var(i) ∝ act_var(i)^β`, a capacity-invariant shape property) and **`R_res_participation`** (a properly weighted size). This one correction retroactively explains three separate historical "rank negatives" across RHM, language, and [mjc](../mjc/contact_residual/README.md) as instances of the same measurement error — a rare case of a single fix dissolving findings across three different experiment lines at once.

## Act 6 — turning RHM into a control task (07-10 → 07-28, current frontier)

[ACTIVE_RHM_README.md](ACTIVE_RHM_README.md) (07-10/11) first asked whether the *reaching*-style control apparatus from [a2a_forward](../a2a_forward/README.md) ports back to RHM's native "reveal a masked block" task. It doesn't, cleanly: a mean-Δ forward model can't plan **epistemic** queries (value-of-information lives in the variance a point estimate discards); a purpose-built VoI/greedy-EIG head fixes it at m=2 but hits a *principled* null at m=4 (the queries are genuinely equally informative given the belief). Phase 4's punchline — **internalizing the forward model has no headroom here** — generalizes into the arc's cleanest concept: RHM's query task is *inference in disguise* (acting ≈ planning), unlike reaching, where a model-free policy can shortcut past ever building a world model. This diagnosis directly motivated **editing** as a genuine control task ([RHM_EDIT_CONTROL_README.md](RHM_EDIT_CONTROL_README.md), 07-11 on): consequences of an edit are deterministic-given-state, so acting ≠ planning again. [RHM_SCULPTING_README.md](RHM_SCULPTING_README.md) then runs six numbered stages, each existing because the last one's apparatus was later shown to be measuring the wrong thing: a "faithful verifier is too sparse to plan" dead end (Stage 2) turned out to be an artifact of grading against one witnessed derivation rather than the true DP optimum ([sculpting_control_task.md](sculpting_control_task.md) quantifies the real coordination prize once fixed); a learned beam then captures it (Stage 3a); latent-space planning is at first only an efficient *surrogate* for token-space (92% of performance, 8x cheaper — Stage 3b) until the arc derives and confirms the unifying principle: **latents beat tokens exactly when tokens stop being a sufficient statistic** — under partial observability and stochastic dynamics (Stages 3c/3d), which is the general real-world case, not the special one. Stage 4-5 show a self-supervised masked-infilling belief objective, remarkably, **beats a privileged ground-truth-ancestor oracle** as a planning substrate (unresolved mechanism), and that only *grounded* (DP-move-imitating) pressure — not endogenous self-predictability alone — deepens a belief's plannable structure, mirroring Act 4's frontier-moving-vs-capped split on the control side. [RHM_SCULPT_CONTINUAL_README.md](RHM_SCULPT_CONTINUAL_README.md) (07-16) asks if this internalization itself compounds under iteration and finds a **weak ratchet**: value-iteration is the real +0.25 compounding lever, internalization a one-shot +0.15 ceiling-setter that saturates in a single pass — echoing Act 3's conclusion that stationary tasks don't sustain compounding, now from the planning side.

The most recent pivot, [directed_sculpting/README.md](directed_sculpting/README.md) (07-28), is groundwork for porting [mjc](../mjc/README.md)'s much larger E3 control experiment onto RHM. The naive port failed immediately as a **confounded null by construction** — RHM's rule usage is uniform, so there is no non-uniform relevance to allocate attention over. Two new primitives (non-tree distractor channels; support-fixed OU-walk drift with a provably invariant DP optimum) manufacture the missing structure, catching along the way that raw cross-entropy is *exactly* algebraically blind to this kind of drift. [`full_loop/README.md`](directed_sculpting/full_loop/README.md) then shows a reward-free relevance signal genuinely separates real tokens from distractors 13-18x with no privileged information — but the headline finding reverses the idea document's original premise: representational **expansion** is gated by *grader type* (grounded task-success vs. endogenous self-predictability), not by non-stationarity — both of the drift-dependent predictions came back negative, twice, after instrument repairs that had each been silently biasing results toward the hoped-for positive. A late "necessity" sweep partially rescues the non-stationarity story by reframing the question (does drift ever get expensive enough that climbing is required, rather than merely possible).

## Threads not yet resolved

- **Specialization** ([specialization/README.md](specialization/README.md), 07-16-18) is the freshest standalone finding and the first clean **RHM-vs-language disanalogy**: concentrating even a *direct* deep target onto a subtree doesn't specialize it, it *hurts* it (broad beats narrow), because RHM's single shared ruleset gives every subtree identical deep structure — there's nothing domain-specific to specialize on. The proposed fix (a context-sensitive, Chomsky-hierarchy-inspired "cut-3" DGP) is unbuilt.
- **Confabulation** ([confabulation/README.md](confabulation/README.md), 07-22) operationalizes "self-report vs. self-theory" via the FM-residual decomposition itself and finds a genuine first-person advantage for reports about the residual (not behavior, not entropy) that survives a 24x capacity sweep — but two pre-registrations failed (the loop turned out to amplify, not gate, the effect; an early 13x closed-vs-open gap was a pure estimator artifact, true gap ~9%), and a planned validated ceiling (`O_act`) simply didn't work.
- The oracle-latent target throughout Act 4 and Act 6 is explicitly a **diagnostic**, not a working mechanism — dropping the privilege (an EMA/data2vec-style self-supervised version) is the single most-repeated "untested next step" across multiple docs, and remains open.
- Whether self-knowledge / internalization *itself* compounds across cycles (the experiment the latent-loop and sculpt-continual docs were each visibly building toward) has still never been run to completion.
